# Lyrenza Rio Copacabana

## Permanent property facts

Lyrenza Rio Copacabana is in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, in the South America region.
Facilities: Rooftop infinity pool; beach service; Brazilian grill. Pool or water-facility hours: 07:00-20:00.
Parking: Valet parking; BRL 95 nightly. Transportation: Beach access across the avenue.

Accessible rooms include step-free routes and must be requested before arrival. Family
services and pet arrangements are confirmed with the reservation team.
